product.title: Isntree Gim PDRN Boosting Glow Pad 70 Pads
product.body_html:
Isntree Gim PDRN Boosting Glow Pad 70 Pads

Description

A soothing toner pad infused with Gim derived PDRN to help improve skin elasticity and restore a healthy, bouncy complexion. Enriched with hydrating ingredients and multiple types of hyaluronic acid, it delivers deep moisture while gently refining skin texture. The soft pad adheres comfortably to the skin, leaving it smooth, plump, and refreshed with a natural glow.


 

How to use

After cleansing, gently wipe the face with the pad to refine skin texture.
For intensive care, place the pad on dry or irritated areas for a few minutes, then remove and pat the remaining essence into the skin.


 

Ingredients

Purified Water, Butylene Glycol, Niacinamide, 1,2 Hexanediol, Glycerin, Glycereth 26, Gluconolactone, Algin, Sodium Hyaluronate, Hyaluronic Acid, Hydroxypropyltrimonium Hyaluronate, Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid, Sodium Acetylated Hyaluronate, Hydrolyzed Sodium Hyaluronate, Sodium Hyaluronate Crosspolymer, Potassium Hyaluronate, Laminaria Japonica Extract (1,010 ppm), Ecklonia Cava Extract, Undaria Pinnatifida Extract, Codium Fragile Extract, Alantoin, Panthenol, Squalane, Beta Glucan, Trehalose, Glyceryl Glucoside, Sodium DNA (100 ppm), Lactobacillus Ferment, Capryloyl Salicylic Acid, Acetyl Hexapeptide 8, Hexapeptide 9, Nonapeptide 1, Palmitoyl Pentapeptide 4, Palmitoyl Tripeptide 1, Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide 7, Xanthan Gum, Ethylhexylglycerin, Sodium Polyacrylate, Adenosine, Melia Azadirachta Flower Extract, Holy Basil Leaf Extract, Curcuma Longa Root Extract, Melia Azadirachta Leaf Extract, Neem Flower Extract, Dextrin, Hydrolyzed Gardenia Extract, Pentylene Glycol, Caprylic Capric Triglyceride, Hydrogenated Lecithin, Disodium EDTA
